retrospective_boundary: The unchanged V2 model had already been diagnostically scored on the SIRT3 controls. These labels and ranks must not be used for V3 architecture, loss-weight, epoch or seed selection.
deployment_query: For each exact new protein sequence, rank the frozen universe of 720 old drugs.

selection_policy.model_selection_data: ChEMBL37 frozen validation plus pre-2023 BindingDB exact-sequence target-cold validation only

label_contract.grey_zone: 5 < pActivity < 6; retained for interval/continuous affinity learning but excluded from strong-vs-weak classification
label_contract.unknown_relation: never converted to a negative label

success_gates.strong_direct_binding: direct experimental Kd or Ki with pActivity >= 6
success_gates.pair_novelty: exact drug-target relationship absent from frozen ChEMBL37 training and the pre-2023 BindingDB training subset
success_gates.teacher_strict_showcase: retrieval_success AND strong_direct_binding AND pair_novelty AND exact target protein absent from the audited relationship database target dictionary
success_gates.claim_policy: SIRT3 can satisfy a strong novel-relation showcase but not the teacher-strict absent-protein gate because SIRT3 itself is present in ChEMBL37. The CHIKV envelope case remains pending until its assayed exact sequence is resolved.

literature.title: An integrated in silico and SPR-based workflow identifies FDA-approved drugs as previously unrecognized SIRT3 binders

database_status.domain_shift: viral heteromeric envelope complex versus a human single-protein training domain
database_status.eligible_for_teacher_strict_absent_prote: pending exact sequence and database audit
